about.title: About MenudaTela
about.paragraph1: {brand} is an online store specializing in the sale of fabrics and textile products. Our goal is to bring you a carefully curated selection of fabrics, for both hobby and professional sewists.
about.paragraph2: We believe in a clear, well-organized catalog with honest information about each fabric so you can choose with confidence without needing to see it in person. Behind every order is a careful process: we prepare and confirm each shipment manually to make sure everything arrives in the expected condition.
about.paragraph3: If you have any questions about our catalog, an order, or anything else, you can write to us from our {link}.

contact.intro: Have a question about an order, a product, or anything else? Write to us and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Do I need to create an account to buy?
items.answer: Yes, you need to register with your email address to place an order. When you create your account you'll receive a confirmation email and can check the status of your purchases from your account area.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We securely process all payments through Stripe, which supports the main credit and debit cards. We never store your full card details.

items.question: When is my order confirmed?
items.answer: After payment you'll receive an email with your order summary. Due to our stock management process, every order is reviewed and manually confirmed by our team before it's prepared for shipping; we'll let you know of any change.

items.question: How long does my order take to arrive?
items.answer: We prepare orders within 24-48 business hours after confirmation. Typical delivery time is 2 to 5 days from shipping, depending on the destination.

items.question: Can I return an order?
items.answer: Yes, you have 30 days from delivery to request a return. You can manage it from your account area on the Shipping & Returns page. Also check our returns policy in the legal section.

items.question: How do I know if a fabric is right for my project?
items.answer: Each product page lists its composition, weight and recommended uses. If you're unsure about a specific fabric, write to us and we'll help you choose the right one.

items.question: How can I contact you?
items.answer: You can write to us at any time through our contact page and we'll reply by email as soon as possible.

faq.footerCta: Didn't find what you were looking for? Email us at {email}.

cookies.intro: At MenudaTela we use cookies and similar technologies to make it easier to browse our website (powered by WooCommerce and Nuxt) and to improve the user experience.
cookies.whatText: A cookie is a small text file that is stored in your browser when you visit almost any website. Its purpose is to let the website remember your visit the next time you browse it.
cookies.typesTechnical: Technical and Session Cookies: These are strictly necessary for the website to function correctly, allowing the user session to be kept once logged into their account and managing the shopping cart.
cookies.typesAnalytics: Analytics / Third-Party Cookies: These help us measure and analyze website traffic to improve our services and our range of fabrics.
cookies.managementIntro: You can allow, block or delete the cookies installed on your device through the settings of the browser installed on your device:
cookies.managementNote: If you disable technical cookies, some store features (such as logging in or the checkout process with WooCommerce) may not work correctly.

terms.intro: These general terms and conditions govern the use of the online fabric sales service at MenudaTela. By registering and placing an order, you expressly accept these terms.
terms.purchaseItem1: To place an order at MenudaTela, creating a user account is mandatory. After registering, you will receive a confirmation email.
terms.purchaseItem2: Once your purchase is complete, we will securely process payment through Stripe and send you an email with the detailed order summary.
terms.purchaseItem3: Manual confirmation: Due to our stock management process, orders must be manually confirmed in our internal system (WordPress) by our team before being prepared and shipped. We will notify you of any change in status.
terms.pricingText: All prices shown on the website include Value Added Tax (VAT) applicable in Spain. Shipping costs will be clearly stated during checkout before confirming the purchase.
terms.returnsItem1: You have the right to request a return within the legally established period (14 calendar days from receipt).
terms.returnsItem2: To start a return, you must contact us or request it from your customer area. This action will generate an internal note in our WordPress admin system to flag that the corresponding refund should be processed.
terms.returnsItem3: Once we have checked the condition of the fabric and compliance with the return conditions, we will process the refund through the original payment method or the agreed channel.

privacy.intro: At {brand} we take the privacy of your personal data very seriously. In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR EU 2016/679) and Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD), we inform you of how we handle your data.
privacy.dataTitle: 2. What Data Do We Collect and for What Purpose?
privacy.dataIntro: In order to provide our online sales services through our platform (built with WooCommerce and a Nuxt frontend), we collect the following data:
privacy.dataAccount: Registration and account data: First name, last name, email address and password. Creating an account is mandatory to place orders (registration confirmation emails are sent).
privacy.dataOrder: Purchase and shipping data: Postal address, phone number and payment details (securely processed through Stripe; MenudaTela does not store your full card details).
privacy.dataManagement: Order and returns management: Information about purchases made, order summaries sent by email, and internal notes generated in our management system (WordPress) if you request a return so your refund can be processed.
privacy.legitimationText: The legal basis for processing your data is the performance of the sales contract and the provision of the services requested when creating your user account and placing orders.
privacy.retentionText: Personal data will be kept for as long as the commercial or user relationship is maintained and, afterwards, for the periods legally required to address any potential tax or legal liabilities.
privacy.rightsText: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection at any time by sending an email to privacidad{'@'}menudatela.com.
